verdict.rationale: ADK documents multiple managed deployment targets—Agent Runtime (fully managed auto-scaling service on Google Cloud), Cloud Run, and GKE—plus a CLI command `adk deploy cloud_run` to ship agents that can then be queried/used in production as an API endpoint. This is first-party documented with concrete CLI usage, though there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the deployed endpoint's API contract. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of the deployed agent's callable API behavior, and more detail on endpoint auth/interface specifics.
